title: First Steps
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels that teach what a platform game is made of: walking, jumping, gravity and ladders. Signs in the levels say what each thing does. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a sign.

box.tagline: Every game starts with a first step.
box.back: A small explorer in a red cap has two short walks to take. Read the signs: they say how walking, jumping, gravity and ladders work. Then open the game in Game-Maker and change one.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Made to be copied and taken apart
